primary.title: Salaried taxpayers: Key checks to make in 2026 for your next ITR — expert explains changes under Income Tax Act 2025
primary.summary: The Income-tax Act, 2025, brings changes that salaried taxpayers will encounter in payroll records, tax forms and their next ITR. From updated section references to revised reporting requirements, here’s what taxpayers should check and keep in mind.
